patch_description: This uses a fractional-routing and congestion approach rather than selecting paths from demand affinity alone. It first softly distributes each OD pair between a direct route and plausible two-hop routes, using constituent-link support and estimated transit-node pressure. It then creates a sparse QUBO approximation to the resulting load-balancing objective: two-hop route rewards are offset by a transit congestion tax on link pairs through busy nodes. The tax also discourages the surrogate from concentrating too many promising routes through the same hubs.
